title: Is anyone else frequently walking on a straight clean rural road?
content: Almost 70% of my dreams start the same. Walking away from a small suburbs down a straight clean concrete rural road that has dense forests on both sides - sometimes autumn, it is always daytime but I can't see the sun, and I am walking home. No cars no people. There are usually crossroads and I tend to go left. First left is more roads where the sun is now setting ahead of me with a weird broken down black house on it, but the next crossroad has left the forest and has no forward. I tend to go left and the world slowly turns white and fades away until I wake up, but sometimes I go right and I see three homes. I will sometimes go in one and hang out with the strangers. But other times to keep walking and find an outdoor shopping mall that is shutting down for the night and I am now stranded in a dark empty plaza at night.
